notes: Universal companion AI 0.8.0. Supports multiple simultaneous henchmen. Every owned ASSOCIATE_TYPE_HENCHMAN gets its own independent XAI combat state and AUTO/FOLLOW/WEAPON mode. Clicking a party portrait selects only which companion the NUI panel and singleton local-Qwen DB bridge inspect/control; other companions keep running independently. Removes Xanos tag/class identity gates, adds periodic attach for companions joining later, retains PRC familiar FIX5 and the existing 0.7.10.7 combat logic. Spellcasting class detection expanded to standard bard/cleric/druid/paladin/ranger/sorcerer/wizard classes.
